name: Party Channel
description: LAN guest page for PARTY_CH — photo/video bulletin, TTS announcements, soundboard, trivia, caption contest, vote-for-next, check-in, visual effects, and reactions. Exposes ctx.services.partyRoutes as an extension point other plugins can add guest-facing routes to on this same server.

ipc.why: receives the live post/announce queue length from the renderer, to answer guests' GET /queue
receives the live vote-for-next-channel tally from the renderer, to answer guests' GET /vote
receives the live trivia round state from the renderer, to answer guests' GET /trivia
captures a still frame from whatever's playing, for the caption contest
returns the join URL/QR code shown on the idle screen and in setup

spawn.why: grabs a still frame from a video file for the caption contest

net.why: the LAN party page guests connect to from their own phone
